desc: Enable battery, charge state and temperatures — needed both for daily use and to know whether the machine is thermally safe under load. MEASURED ABSENCES in config-hid-type-fix: MACSMC is absent, CONFIG_MACSMC_POWER is explicitly not set, CONFIG_HWMON is not set. CONFIG_POWER_SUPPLY=y already. So there is currently no battery percentage, no charging state and no temperature reading anywhere. TASK: enable MACSMC (+ MACSMC_POWER, MACSMC_HWMON, HWMON) in the full kernel, confirm the SMC node in the J614s DT, and verify /sys/class/power_supply/* and /sys/class/hwmon/* populate. POLICY: this is READ-ONLY telemetry and stays inside the standing rules — smc_reboot and smc_rtc nvram writes are permitted, but charger and PMU-voltage writes remain FORBIDDEN, so do not enable or exercise any charge-control interface. Feeds the status bar in 166.
author: claude
note: 2026-07-27 config is easy, the DT node is not safely derivable from the captured ADT. macsmc is in-tree (MFD_MACSMC + children). The Linux apple,smc DT model (t602x-die0.dtsi) needs: smc@ node with reg-names 'smc'(0x4000)+'sram'(0x100000), an apple,asc-mailbox-v4 mbox node at smc_base+0x8000 with 4 AIC IRQs, and gpio/hwmon/reboot/rtc children. FROM THE ADT (j614s-usb-port-map): smc 'iop,ascwrap-v6' at cpu 0x50c600000 (sz 0x88000) + 0x50c050000 + 0x50c810000, interrupt-parent 242, interrupts 997/996/999/998. So the mailbox IRQs ARE known. BUT the ascwrap regs do NOT give an obvious ~1 MiB 'sram' region (the t602x sram was at a separate 0x...3e00000 base, 0x1a00000 from the smc base); the ADT's three ascwrap regs are 0x88000/0x4000/0x100, none a 0x100000 SRAM. Mapping sram wrong ships a faulting driver. NEEDS: the SMC SRAM carveout address (from a fuller ADT read of the memory-map/iop-smc-nub, or a t6030/t6040 Linux DT if one appears upstream). IRQs + smc base are captured; only the SRAM region blocks authoring.
result: 2026-07-28 UNBLOCKED. All addresses in hand (172): smc mailbox 0x50c600000, sram 0x50e000000 (0x100000, pattern-inferred), mbox at 0x50c608000, IRQs 997/996/999/998. Full apple,smc node drafted in done/2026-07-28-t6040-smc-adt-and-sram-carveout.md, templated on t602x-die0.dtsi. NEXT (offline, no rig): finalise the node (confirm mbox IRQ order + mbox reg vs ascwrap sub-reg against the saved ADT/t602x), enable MFD_MACSMC + SENSORS_MACSMC_HWMON + RTC_DRV_MACSMC + HWMON, build the feature kernel (fold in usbnet 167), produce a strict-verified candidate object. Read-only telemetry; charger/PMU writes stay forbidden.
